text: Press B to shoot, but only if you have ammo, and shooting uses one ammo.
reply:
Pressing B now shoots, but only while you have ammo, and each shot uses one. The game builds, all its checks pass, and I updated the saved test run so finished games can still be checked fairly for the leaderboard.

- **Shooting:** pressing B fires one bullet in the direction your player last walked and plays the shooting sound. Holding B down doesn't keep firing; you press once for each shot.
- **Ammo:** your player starts each run with 5 shots. With no ammo left, B does nothing.
- **Screen:** the top line now shows "Ammo:" next to score, lives and coins.
- **Bullets:** they fly straight and are removed once they leave the screen. They don't hit anything yet, so they pass through enemies.
- **Getting more ammo:** there's no way to pick up more yet, so once your 5 are gone, they're gone for that run.

I haven't saved these changes as a new version yet; they're ready whenever you are.

READBACK: Pressing B fires one bullet the way your player is facing, but only if you have ammo, and each shot uses one. You start every run with 5, shown as "Ammo" at the top of the screen, and with none left B does nothing. I assumed you can't get more ammo during a run and that bullets just fly off the screen without hitting anything.
